values.note: 65 sites with water and electric (some also sewer) and 25 without.

values.note: 'To make a reservation for camping at Pioneer Park, please use the site FireFly.' Check-in 1-4 pm daily. One camping unit and two vehicles per site; 'Campsites are not a residence.'

note: Hardee County 115-acre park along the Peace River at US-17/SR-64 in Zolfo Springs. Larger rigs in a pull-through parking-lot-style loop, smaller in wooded areas. Passport America park. Museum, wildlife refuge, boat ramp. --Claude
